run_2035_ref_v4.name: Vehicle-km travelled, AM
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: Sum of link volume x length for user_class ALL in the AM period.

run_2035_ref_v4.name: Share of links with V/C above 1.0, AM
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: Links with vc_ratio > 1.0 divided by all links carrying flow, AM, user_class ALL.

run_2035_ref_v4.name: Volume-weighted congested speed, AM
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: Sum(volume x congested speed) / Sum(volume) for AM, user_class ALL.

run_2035_ref_v4.name: Total demand trips, AM
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: Sum of all DEMAND matrix cells in the AM period, all purposes and modes.

run_2035_ref_v4.name: PT mode share, AM
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: PT demand trips divided by all demand trips, AM.

run_2035_ref_v4.name: Mean trip length, all periods
run_2035_ref_v4.definition: Trip-weighted mean of the DIST skim over DEMAND matrix cells.
